newsitem.title: USA: GPU sees Oyster Creek nuke fully back today.
newsitem.headline: GPU sees Oyster Creek nuke fully back today.

text.p: General Public Utilities Corp's (GPU) said Thursday its 610 megawatt (MW) Oyster Creek nuclear power station was expected to resume full output later today following a outage that began September 4.
"We will be back to full power later today," said a company spokeswoman, adding the plant began contributing electricity to the grid late Wednesday.
Startup of the Forked River, N.J., generating station was pushed back from last weekend due to a steam leak in a reheater.
"Now we're just increasing power throughout the day. We're at 63 percent power," she said.
About 22 percent of GPU's electricity production comes from nuclear power plants.
